$comment: Per-shot settings for tools/photo/clean_lightbox.py. Coordinates are pixels in the oriented original. F01 three-quarter (A2) from the wearer's right; the near temple runs off the left edge, so the photographer's crop is kept. The engraved wordmark and old emblem on the blue tortoise temple come off stroke by stroke (rebuilding the whole patch would smear the tortoise). The GCD goes on the right temple from the hinge line; the temple's face is seen at about 44 degrees: the old print's block is 1.9 times as long as it is tall here and about 2.7 times on the near-straight views (IMG_3558, IMG_3579).

marks.name: engraved wordmark and old emblem, near temple (inset from the temple's edges, which the stroke detector would otherwise take for strokes)
